ቀተሎ: ቀተለ — he killed him (3m sg perfect + -o, q-t-l)
ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
ለወልደ: ወልድ — the son of (ለ- marking the object + noun, construct) · to the son of (ለ- 'to', dative, parallel to ለንጉሥ: ሀቦ ... ለወልደ ንጉሥ 'give ... to the king's son')
ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
ወውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — and he, as for him (ወ- + pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
ወልድ: ወልድ — son (the Son) · a son in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ 'a father's blessing upon a son')
ወይቤላ: ይቤ — and he said to her (ወ- + 3ms perfect of defective ይቤ + -ላ '3fs to her') · masculine form where a woman speaks to her sister and ትቤላ is expected (ወይቤላ ዝንቱ ንዋየ አቡነ 'and she said to her: this property of our father') (?)
ለእሙ: እም — to his mother (ለ- + noun 'mother' + -ሁ '3ms his', giving እሙ)
ወትቤሎ: ይቤ — and she said to him (ወ- + 3fs ትቤ of defective ይቤ + -ሎ '3ms to him')
እሙ: እም — his mother (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted እሙ) · 'its mother' of an animal (ጽጉበ ሐሊበ እሙ 'sated with its mother's milk'; ch. 53)
ኅድግ: ኀደገ — leave! (2ms imperative, G, ḫ-d-g; Bezold's spelling ኅድግ)
ኢኮነት: ኮነ — she was not (ኢ- 'not' + 3fs perfect, G, k-w-n)
ወኢኮነ: ኮነ — and was/is not (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, k-w-n)
ሀገሩ: ሀገር — his city, 'the city of' (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', anticipating ለንጉሥ)
ወአንተሰ: አንተ — and as for you (ወ- + 2ms pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
ለእመ: እመ — if (conditional conjunction, ለእመ) · 'whether', introducing an indirect question (ለእመ ብኪ ትትባረክ 'whether through you she will be blessed') (?) · ለ- + እም 'mother' in construct: 'to the mother of' (ለእመ ዝንቱ ወሬዛ 'to the mother of this lad')
አበዊከ: አብ — your fathers (noun, plural አበው + -ka '2ms your')
ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
አቡከ: አብ — father (noun, genitive after construct; + -ከ 'your', 2ms, form አቡ-)
አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
በዝየ: ዝየ — here (በ- + adverb ዝየ 'here'; the በ- adds nothing to the sense)
ወአሐተ: አሐቲ — and one (ወ- + numeral, fem., accusative አሐተ)
ዕለተ: ዕለት — day (noun, fem., construct state 'day-of') · also the accusative singular after a numeral (፯ ዕለተ 'seven days')
ሰክሩ: ሰክረ — they got drunk (3mp perfect, G)
ኀለፈ: ኀለፈ — he/it passed away (3ms perfect, G, ḫ-l-f)
ክልኤሆን: ክልኤቱ — both of them (feminine; numeral 'two' + -ሆን '3fp', of the hands)
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
ወአሐቲ: አሐዱ — and one (ወ- + numeral, fem. አሐቲ)
ወነሥአ: ነሥአ — and he took (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel')
መክሳባ: መክሳባ — Meksaba (proper name; the Philistine queen in this tradition)
ወአውፅአ: አውፅአ — and he brought out (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ወፅአ)
ወወድቀት: ወድቀ — and it fell (ወ- + 3fs perfect, w-d-q)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown')
ቤት: ቤት — house (noun) · construct 'house of' (ቤት ስብሐቲከ 'house of your glory'; ሰብአ ቤት 'men of the house')
እዴሁ: እድ — his hand (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; with suffix እዴ-)
እማቲሆሙ: አመት — their maidservants (?) (plural አእማት + -ሆሙ '3mp their', written without the initial አ; አመት 'maidservant') (?)
ወይእቲሰ: ይእቲ — and she, as for her (ወ- + fem. pronoun + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
ወነሥአት: ነሥአ — and she took (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
ወተንሥአት: ተንሥአ — and she arose (ወ- + 3fs perfect, tä-stem)
ወሖረት: ሖረ — and she went (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G)
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
ትብል: ብህለ — she says (3fs imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying') · 2ms 'you say' (ሶበ ጸብሐ ትብል 'when it is morning you say')
ወዝንቱሰ: ዝንቱ — and this one indeed (ወ- + m. demonstrative + emphatic -ሰ)
ኢይክል: ከህለ — none can (ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, G, k-h-l)
ኒዒ: ንዓ — come! (imperative 2fs, written ኒዒ for ንዒ; ms ንዓ, pl ንዑ)
ወአንሥአት: አንሥአ — and she lifted (ወ- + 3fs perfect, causative of the root ነሥአ)
ዘሜላት: ሜላት — unknown word (ዘ- + noun), perhaps a material or craft term; meaning from context (?)
ወወሀበቶ: ወሀበ — and she gave him (ወ- + 3fs perfect + -ኦ '3ms him', joined as ቶ)
ወትነብር: ነበረ — and she sits, dwells (ወ- + 3fs imperfect) · also 2ms 'and you will dwell' (ወትነብር ውስተ ብሔርነ)
መንግሥተ: መንግሥት — kingdom (construct 'kingdom of') · also the plain accusative 'a kingdom' (ዘይነፍቅ መንግሥተ 'who would seize a kingdom')
ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two') · 3ms form before a plural subject (ኮነ መዋዕሊሁ ፷ 'his days were sixty'); 'there was' (ኮነ ረኃብ 'there was a famine')
ፀዋገ: ፀዋግ — captor, one who takes captive (noun; accusative; lexical call from context) (?)
ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
ነሥአ: ነሥአ — he took (3ms perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
ሜላተ: ሜላተ — obscure word for something spread or laid (accusative; maybe a covering) (?)
ወወፅአ: ወፅአ — and he went out (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-ṣ-ʾ)
መሐዛት: መሐዛት — unidentified plural noun, subject of ወወውዑ (lemma not recovered) (?)
ወትቤሎሙ: ይቤ — and she said to them (ወ- + 3fs perfect ትቤ of the irregular verb 'say' + ሎሙ 'to them')
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
ይነብር: ነበረ — he stays, dwells (3ms imperfect, G, n-b-r) · he sits, is seated (3ms imperfect, G, of sitting at table)
ወአንበርዎ: አንበረ — and they made him settle (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of ነበረ + -ዎ '3ms him')
ወሠርዑ: ሠርዐ — and they laid down, established (ወ- + 3mp perfect)
ወተፈሥሑ: ተፈሥሐ — and they rejoiced (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem)
ወእምአሜሃ: አሜሃ — and from then, from that time (ወ- + እም- 'from' + adverb 'then')
ነግሠ: ነግሠ — he reigned (3m sg perfect, n-g-š)
ላዕሌሆሙ: ላዕለ — upon them, over them (preposition + 3mp suffix)
ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
ዘተዐደወ: ተዐደወ — who transgressed, departed (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, tä-stem of ዐደወ)
እምዘ: ዘ — from him who (እም- + relative pronoun) · 'beyond what' (እምዘ ኢተሐዘብኩ 'beyond what I had expected') · 'from what' (እምዘ ንኤዝዘከ 'from what we command you') · 'since' of time (እምዘ ኀለፉ 'since they passed')
፭: ፭ — 5, spoken ኀምስቱ (ḫaməstu) 'five'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'five' (፭ ስሑታን 'five erring ones'; spoken ኀምስቱ before a masculine) · spoken ኀምስ (ḫaməs) before a feminine noun (፭ ዓመተ 'five years')
ዘተወልደ: ተወልደ — who was born (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, passive/reflexive stem of ወለደ)
ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh' · accusative 'a slave' after አልቦ (ወአልቦ ገብረ 'and there is no slave')
ወለዘርኡ: ዘርእ — and to his seed (ወ- + ለ- + noun + -ሁ 'his')
ተዐውቀ: ዐወቀ — it was/has become known (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ዐወቀ 'know' (?); rendered as a present 'it is known')
ለዘርአ: ዘርእ — to the seed of (ለ- + noun, construct)
